negative_reviews.author: スペースoppaikunt
negative_reviews.text: Waited at least 20 minutes for a server, couple next to us didn’t get their second main until after their first meal. Server didn’t come back to us again until around 20 minutes after we finished our main for our pre-ordered dessert. Forgot spoons as well for dessert. Food was good, nothing crazy of course. Broth was very well done and rich, but the pork slices were tough and only got two for a large portion.

negative_reviews.author: Mai
negative_reviews.text:
Disappointing experience - had to wait for ages, my bowl of ramen was cold when it was finally served, didn't even get my water. People next to me were only served half of the dishes they ordered and even though they asked a few times, it never came, making them cancel their order in the end. I came here because of the positive reviews for the vegan ramen but the experience was not worth it (ramen were also just ok and, as said above, cold).

Sidenote: The state of the toilets was really awful

negative_reviews.author: Ruth Ashley
negative_reviews.text: Great food and great service from staff but the condition of the restaurant really lets this place down. i’m a huge fan of maki and ramen in edinburgh and was excited that they’re in london now but this particular restaurant had a very strong smell of damp, and the toilets were in terrible condition. i’m really hoping these were just temporary problems but we felt the setting was just a bit run down to be a nice place to eat.

negative_reviews.author: Tierdish
negative_reviews.text:
Rude waitress but very good ramen. She made a weird face and laughed at us when we asked if we could put a food item on the side due to our friends dietary requirements.
We did feel quite uncomfortable and weirded out by this.
The food itself was good but this was very strange
